note: Balances read from explorer labels on the date shown. Exchange wallets custody user funds; they are not owned by the exchange. Wallets rotate over time, so figures drift between updates. Verify live on the linked explorers.
eth_dispersed_note: Ethereum's largest holders are DEX pools and the Base bridge, not exchange wallets. Around 92% of ETH RIO is spread across retail addresses, with no single dominant holder.
